answer: A Sybil defense for agent economies is a stake-weighted admission gate. Each new agent must lock a bond that scales with how many identities already share its funding source, and the bond stays locked while it works. To run ten thousand puppet accounts, an attacker posts ten thousand escalating bonds plus fees, and that capital sits idle the entire lock window. So a kernel of real agents is nearly free, while a summit of fakes demands large, unrecoverable funds that grow quadratically. A small saffron burn on first registration makes every duplicate permanently costly.
